headline: Order to transfer $11,173,912.75 in certified free cash into two city stabilization funds.
summary: Councillor Carey McDonald sponsored the order. It would send $10,158,102.50 to the General Purpose Stabilization Fund and $1,015,810.25 to the Short Term Capital Needs Stabilization Fund.
items: Order 454-26: transfer $11,173,912.75 from available certified free cash to stabilization funds
